## Scope

A quality audit was undertaken for graded sets in the period under review. A sample of 417 graded sets was selected and read again by a second grader. The purpose was to assess the consistency of grading between the original and second reviews. The review considered whether the grades assigned to each set were the same. It did not replace the original grades or alter the grading process. The sample provides a basis for reviewing agreement and identifying any issues requiring follow-up.

## Result

The first and second grades agreed in 69.8 per cent of sets. This result indicates the level of agreement observed within the audited sample. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet for reference. The findings are also discussed with each grader privately, allowing any questions or concerns to be considered directly. Further review can be undertaken where the results or individual grading patterns indicate that clarification or support may be appropriate.
